| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `query` | Evaluate an instant PromQL query at a single time (current value / snapshot). query is PromQL (e.g. "up", "rate(http_requests_total[5m])"). Optional time (ISO 8601 or relative like now-5m; defaults to now). Anchor time to the incident onset, not the current time. |
| `query_range` | Evaluate a PromQL query over a time range (a series). query is PromQL; start/end are ISO 8601 or relative (now-1h); step is a resolution like "15s"/"1m" (defaults to ~250 points across the window). Anchor start/end to the incident onset. Returns a matrix of series. |
| `series` | Find series matching label matchers. match is one or more selectors (e.g. ["up", "{job=\"api\"}"]). Optional start/end (ISO 8601 or relative). Use to discover what series exist. |
| `labels` | List label names, optionally constrained by match selectors and a time range. Use to discover the label schema (e.g. what dimensions exist). |
| `label_values` | List the values of one label name (e.g. name="job" → all job values). Optionally constrained by match selectors. |
| `metadata` | Read metric metadata (type, help text, unit). Optional metric to filter to one name; optional limit. Use to understand what a metric measures. |
| `targets` | List scrape targets and their health (up/down, last scrape, errors) — the "what is not being scraped" signal. Optional state: "active", "dropped", or "any" (default active). |
| `rules` | List alerting and recording rules and their current state. Optional type: "alert" or "record". |
| `alerts` | List the alerts currently firing (and pending) — the "what is on fire right now" signal. |
| `api_get` | GET any Prometheus HTTP API endpoint by path (e.g. "api/v1/status/config", "api/v1/status/runtimeinfo", "api/v1/alertmanagers", "api/v1/targets/metadata"). Read-only. Use for anything the named tools do not cover. |
